---
description: "Project progress table maintenance"
applyTo: "PROJECT_PROGRESS.md,PRD.md,TECH_SPEC.md,AGENTS.md"
---

Keep a visible implementation progress table in the dedicated `PROJECT_PROGRESS.md` file and update it whenever feature status changes.

- Track each core product capability with a clear status such as `已实现`, `部分实现`, or `未实现`.
- Keep the table aligned with the current codebase state.
- When product scope changes, update both the progress file and the related PRD/technical notes.
